steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: ****, why on earth are you still here?!

A marker lands on Christina's forehead. She yelps, finally shifting her gaze from the detective handbook, meeting the gaze of all the people in the investigation team. Her overthinking just now leaves her momentarily disoriented.
The inspector blushes at his own words, but feels a sense of relief when he realizes that Christina didn't hear them.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Get out of here. You're so badly injured, I won't be able to explain it to your higher-ups later. If the suspect is the leader of the Garden, there's no place for a rookie like you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'm fine! That woman treats lives as a joke and she will do even worse things. She's targeting me and the people important to me, I must stop her.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And I... I've solved many cases related to the Sinners. I have experience, I can help!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: All you've done is catch thieves and handle lost and found cases, can you compare those to a murder case like this?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Um... I'm not afraid, I...

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: This case is more complicated than we imagined, I don't know how deeply it's connected to the case in N.F. 103 or the FAC, but no matter what, you shouldn't get yourself involved.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I know about your situation, your father was with the FAC, he died in N.F. 103. You've never dealt with a murder case, and you have a history of mental instability.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I won't delve into the connection behind this, nor care about the reason why you were assigned here. But now that the Garden has targeted you, and I've seen that you're easy to provoke, I'm determining that you're not suitable for this case after assessing the risk.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...I... It's okay. I'm not that fragile. And... this is a job entrusted to me by a very important person.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I don't care how important that big shot is, this isn't something an intern should get involved in! I can't be held responsible if you lose your life! Go back and rest, don't hang around here with us.
Christina clenches her fists, staying up all night makes her both excited and defeated, her emotions are suppressed with nowhere to vent.
Just then, a familiar and unique ringtone rings. Christina jumps up, her eyes gleaming.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Wait, it's an important call! I have to pick it up! We'll talk when I come back!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Hey!
She runs as if she's flying, all the way to the ladies' room, then catches her breath, swallows her saliva. With unease and excitement, she presses the answer key.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Shalom?

steps.speaker: Encrypted Comms
steps.content: It's me.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah, Rahu...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Is Shalom okay? Are you guys coming back?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No. The situation is more complicated than expected, the mission needs more time. But Shalom is worried about your situation, and asked me to check on you.
"So she knows that I failed." Christina is a bit annoyed.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'm sorry, I was inexperienced and hot-headed. I let the criminal escape, and made you guys worry.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Compared to me, Shalom's task is a hundred times more difficult, and the enemies she faces are a hundred times more dangerous. In the end, she has to be distracted by my matters.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Say that to her yourself. Shalom asked me to contact you to provide information. I've dealt with a few assassins from the Garden, they're not psychopaths who kill for fun.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Apart from accepting commissions, the Garden's actions are usually highly purposeful and very much driven by sentiment.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: From the series of cases you've taken over, the Garden intentionally connected several isolated incidents to create a sense of ritual. This sense of ritual has a purpose, Shalom hopes that you can figure it out.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: They rarely act so ostentatiously, this is an opportunity. We have already sent people to track down the <color=#fb9259>Garden's base</color>.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Strong connections... I think I have an idea.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: And there's one last thing she asked me to convey.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Shalom says she'll be there for you whenever you need her, but she believes you can do it.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...O-okay! Thank you for the clues you gave me, thank you, Shalom! I know what to do now!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: These guys, having ties with the Underground forces and still insisting on causing trouble at the most critical moment of the battle... I won't let them off.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: When I'm not around, you have to protect her. Special force Rahu, I'm counting on you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Of course, I won't let her die. That's the order given to me.
After hanging up the phone, Christina slaps her face hard... Clap!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Alright! I'm fully charged! To live up to everyone's expectations, the famous great detective will continue to shine and illuminate the darkness!
She doesn't return to the investigation team, but heads straight to the next investigation site...
The Public Security Bureau has investigated Nathan's file. It can be confirmed that he was smuggled into Eastside from Syndicate ten years ago. His experiences before that are a blank slate.

Not long after he smuggled into Eastside, he opened a large construction company and took on many projects. But the company's performance was not ideal, and it has been losing money for the past ten years.

Under these circumstances, large amounts of unexplained funds have been constantly flowing into Nathan's personal account. Although these funds are well-managed and no discrepancies can be found, this itself is enough to prove that there's something wrong with Nathan.
Christina arrives at Nathan's house. Just like his file, Nathan's house is also cleaned very "neatly," nothing out of the ordinary...
Except for a handwritten phone book, which has Anania's number. The corresponding name is written in code.
Christina follows up and checks a few other numbers in the phone book. Most of these contacts are wealthy businessmen engaged in charity work, and there's also a high-ranking official in Eastside.
Perhaps, like Anania, they were all potential blackmail targets chosen by Nathan.

Christina discovers that Anania did some online searches about Nathan after receiving his "text message." However, according to the records, her searches focused on Nathan's construction company, not Nathan himself.
Following her search records, Christina finds that Anania was indeed purposefully collecting information.
Nathan's construction company often gets involved in disputes related to the quality of the project, and these disputes all end up being minimized or dismissed in the end.

The most recent project record is a demolition project of a building ruin on the east bank of the Rust, but for some reason, it has been in a state of suspension... Online rumors say that the place is haunted, and no workers would dare to go.
Christina does some checking and finds that this building was originally built by Nathan's company, but it was abruptly halted midway, which is why it became a ruin.
From construction to suspension, from the decision to demolish it to another suspension, so many questions regarding this ten-year-long project...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: On a night of rains, fireflies glide; by fractured walls, shadows of ruins reside.
Ruins... ruins...

She unfolds the map and carefully searches around the Rust, corresponding to the "construction project" sites that Nathan once took on. Some of them have been completed, some have long been demolished. The only one left is an unfinished broken wall, like an urban legend that can't be demolished...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Found it!
